targets.name: Watch partly under the leather flap
targets.concealment: A leather flap crosses the watch face and its bronze rim repeats the journal's buckles and tooling.

targets.name: Spectacle frames among the twine
targets.concealment: Fine gold rims follow curved parcel string, with a paper corner overlapping one side.

targets.name: Letter opener under the papers
targets.concealment: The long narrow blade follows paper edges and part of the hilt is covered by stacked envelopes.

targets.name: Fountain pen against the felt
targets.concealment: The brown-and-gold pen lies along a dark journal edge and disappears into similarly colored felt and leather.

targets.name: Round pocket lens under the plaid
targets.concealment: The low oval rim is partly beneath the scarf and blends into the suitcase's brass corners.

targets.name: Cleaning brush in the straw
targets.concealment: Packing straw crosses the bristles and echoes both the bristle texture and the handle's wood grain.

targets.name: Small folding knife among papers
targets.concealment: Its diagonal engraved edge lies between similarly slanting papers and dark book-spine marks.

targets.name: Brass hasp on the parcel crate
targets.concealment: The narrow aged plate is integrated into crate joinery and partly meets the leather strap.

targets.name: Wooden bird on the crate
targets.concealment: The shallow bird relief shares the slatted wood grain and a strap breaks its right edge.

targets.name: Bronze dragonfly clasp on the felt
targets.concealment: Dark metal and wing-vein texture blend with the green felt and nearby thread, with a paper edge crossing one wing.

targets.name: Small wooden key beside the stamp
targets.concealment: Its brown shaft sits in the stamp's shadow and merges with the surrounding desk grain.

targets.name: Brass ticket-printing machine
targets.concealment: Large polished machine is the central desk anchor.

targets.name: Large counter bell
targets.concealment: The shiny brass bell is unobscured on the counter.

targets.name: Brass railway lantern
targets.concealment: The large glass and brass lantern hangs clearly on the left.

targets.name: Long leather glove on the chair
targets.concealment: Large familiar gloves are an easy foreground anchor.

review.notes: Every target inspected against the finished source and regenerated contour context sheets. Names, full visible defining features, occlusion edges and negative-space holes repaired where needed. Difficulty is an authored estimate; physical iPhone/player calibration remains pending.
